ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $AD$ perpendicularly bisects $BC$ at $D$, $\angle BAC=45^\circ$, $CE \perp AB$ at $E$, intersecting $AD$ at $F$, and $BD=2$. What is the length of $AF$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $AD$ vertically bisects $BC$, and $BD=2$, \\
it follows that $BC=2BD=4$, \\
since $CE\perp AB$, \\
it follows that $\angle CEB=90^\circ$, \\
thus, $\angle AEC=90^\circ$, \\
given that $\angle BAC=45^\circ$, \\
it follows that $\angle ACE=90^\circ-45^\circ=45^\circ$, \\
hence, $\angle EAC=\angle ACE$, \\
thus, $AE=CE$, \\
since $AD$ vertically bisects $BC$, \\
it follows that $\angle ADB=90^\circ$, \\
thus, $\angle B+\angle BAD=90^\circ$, \\
given that $\angle B+\angle BCE=90^\circ$, \\
it follows that $\angle BAD=\angle BCE$, \\
in $\triangle AEF$ and $\triangle CEB$, we have $\left\{\begin{array}{l}\angle AEF=\angle CEB \\ AE=CE \\ \angle EAF=\angle BCE\end{array}\right.$, \\
therefore, $\triangle AEF\cong \triangle CEB\left(ASA\right)$, \\
hence, $AF=BC= \boxed{4}$.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram as triangle ABC with B-D-C collinear on the base, AD drawn from A to midpoint D of BC, E on AB, and CE meeting AD at F. From the text, AD perpendicularly bisects BC and BD=2, so BC=4. Since CE is perpendicular to AB and E lies on AB, triangle AEC is right at E. With angle BAC=45°, and AE lying on AB, triangle AEC is a 45-45-90 triangle, so AE=CE. Next compare triangles AEF and CEB: both have a right angle at E; angle EAF equals angle BCE because each is complementary to the same base angle at B, using AD perpendicular BC and CE perpendicular AB. Therefore triangles AEF and CEB are congruent by ASA. Corresponding sides give AF=CB=4.

method.CoT_final: 图像描述：图中 A 在上方，B、D、C 位于下方同一直线 BC 上，D 在 B 与 C 之间；AD 从 A 垂直连到 D，是 BC 的垂直平分线；E 在 AB 上，线段 CE 从 C 连到 E，并与 AD 相交于 F；F 位于 A 和 D 之间。推理：由 AD 垂直平分 BC 且 BD=2，可得 DC=2。因为 A 在 BC 的垂直平分线上，所以 AB=AC，三角形 ABC 为等腰三角形，AD 同时平分顶角 ∠BAC。已知 ∠BAC=45°，所以 ∠BAD=22.5°。在直角三角形 ABD 中，tan22.5°=BD/AD，因此 AD=2/tan22.5°=2(√2+1)。又因为 CE⊥AB，所以 CE 与底边 CB 的锐角为 22.5°。在直角三角形 CDF 中，DC=2，且 tan22.5°=DF/DC，所以 DF=2tan22.5°=2(√2−1)。图中 F 在 A 与 D 之间，因此 AF=AD−DF=2(√2+1)−2(√2−1)=4。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, $AD$ perpendicularly bisects $BC$ at $D$, $\angle BAC=45^\circ$, $CE \perp AB$ at $E$, intersecting $AD$ at $F$, and $BD=2$. What is the length of $AF$?
raw_record.answer:
Given that $AD$ vertically bisects $BC$, and $BD=2$, \\
it follows that $BC=2BD=4$, \\
since $CE\perp AB$, \\
it follows that $\angle CEB=90^\circ$, \\
thus, $\angle AEC=90^\circ$, \\
given that $\angle BAC=45^\circ$, \\
it follows that $\angle ACE=90^\circ-45^\circ=45^\circ$, \\
hence, $\angle EAC=\angle ACE$, \\
thus, $AE=CE$, \\
since $AD$ vertically bisects $BC$, \\
it follows that $\angle ADB=90^\circ$, \\
thus, $\angle B+\angle BAD=90^\circ$, \\
given that $\angle B+\angle BCE=90^\circ$, \\
it follows that $\angle BAD=\angle BCE$, \\
in $\triangle AEF$ and $\triangle CEB$, we have $\left\{\begin{array}{l}\angle AEF=\angle CEB \\ AE=CE \\ \angle EAF=\angle BCE\end{array}\right.$, \\
therefore, $\triangle AEF\cong \triangle CEB\left(ASA\right)$, \\
hence, $AF=BC= \boxed{4}$
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the attached figure, A is above, B is at the lower left, and C is at the lower right, forming triangle ABC. D is located on the base BC, and AD connects from A to D; E is located on AB; the line segment CE drawn from C passes through E and intersects AD at F. In the figure, it can be seen that B, D, C are collinear, E, A, B are collinear, and F is at the intersection point of AD and CE.
Reasoning: From the problem statement, AD perpendicularly bisects BC at D, and BD=2, so DC=2, BC=BD+DC=4. Because CE ⟂ AB at E, and E is on AB, ∠AEC=90°, ∠CEB=90°. Also because ∠BAC=45°, and AE is on AB, ∠EAC=45°. In right triangle AEC, ∠ACE=90°-45°=45°, therefore ∠EAC=∠ACE, obtaining AE=CE. Next compare △AEF and △CEB: Since EF is on CE and AE is on AB, CE ⟂ AB, so ∠AEF=∠CEB=90°. Also because AD ⟂ BC, in △ABD there is ∠B+∠BAD=90°; and in △CEB, ∠B+∠BCE=90°, so ∠BAD=∠BCE. Since E is on AB and F is on AD, ∠EAF=∠BAD, therefore ∠EAF=∠BCE. Thus △AEF and △CEB have two angles and the included side correspondingly equal: ∠AEF=∠CEB, AE=CE, ∠EAF=∠BCE, hence △AEF≅△CEB (ASA). Corresponding side AF=CB=4.
